turns.text: Sure, well, basically the exam is one on one with an examiner takes about 11 to 14 minutes and there are three sections or three parts to the exam.
turns.zh: 嗯，基本上考试是一对一跟考官进行的，大概11到14分钟，考试分三个部分。

turns.text: Okay, and we're just doing part one today, right?
turns.zh: 好的，那我们今天只做第一部分，对吧？

turns.text: Well, the examiner actually gives you four scores.
turns.zh: 嗯，考官其实会给你四个分数。

turns.text: And there are four separate criteria.
turns.zh: 而且有四个独立的评分标准。

turns.text: So you will get a score for fluency and coherence, lexical resource.
turns.zh: 所以你会得到一个流利度和连贯性的分数，还有词汇资源。
